motion.title: Motion
motion.hint_full: Springy transitions and bunnies that join in.
motion.hint_reduced: Calmer: nothing flies around, transitions only fade softly.
motion.hint_off: No animations. A tap still answers right away.
motion.system_reduced: Your device asks for less motion – so it stays at least calmer here.
motion.battery_active: The battery is almost empty – saving right now.
motion.night_hint: From 11 pm to 7 am {{bunny}} and {{hamster}} sleep. Tap to wake them.
motion.battery: Save when the battery is low
motion.battery_hint: Below 20 % and not charging: fewer animations automatically
motion.battery_unsupported: This browser does not tell the battery level (for example Safari on iPhone) – automatic saving cannot work here.
motion.feedback_hint: Brief feedback for taps and confirmations.
motion.feedback_no_vibration: The iPhone browser does not vibrate. Brief sounds confirm your actions.
motion.shake_hint: Shake your phone – {{bunny}} gets dizzy for a moment. The iPhone needs your permission for motion data.
motion.shake_denied: Not allowed – you can try again later.
